_context: Held-out baseline for 8 stratified queries (3 multi / 2 fact / 2 paraphrase / 1 exact) split out of the DORA tier and computed by subset aggregation from the same captured qdrant hybrid + Cohere-rerank-v4.0-pro + contextual-retrieval result. This tier is never a tuning target and is used only as an overfitting-regression gate; a tuning tier that improves while this one regresses indicates overfitting.
